papers.title: Impact of Artificial Intelligence on Software Engineering Phases and Activities (2013-2024): A Quantitative Analysis Using Zero-Truncated Poisson Model
papers.methods: Systematic quantitative literature analysis and Zero-Truncated Poisson statistical modeling across SDLC phases.
papers.findings: AI integration significantly improves accuracy and efficiency in requirement engineering, planning, and software defect prediction.
papers.documented_limitations: Class imbalance in defect datasets, limited dataset diversity, scalability across large repositories, and low model interpretability.
papers.suggested_direction: Build an interpretable defect-prediction pipeline using balanced open-source repository datasets on standard CPU hardware.

papers.title: GUI test case minimization using sequence mining
papers.methods: Sequential pattern mining combined with cosine-similarity K-Means clustering to eliminate redundant GUI regression test sequences.
papers.findings: Reduces regression test suite size while preserving full UI control coverage.
papers.documented_limitations: Limited industrial evaluation on dynamic web interfaces and sensitivity to non-deterministic UI state transitions.
papers.suggested_direction: Extend sequence-mining test minimization to dynamic web applications with asynchronous state changes.

papers.title: A hybrid deep learning model for user story effort estimation
papers.authors: Malik S, Hamid M, Saleem M
papers.methods: Hybrid BERT contextual embeddings paired with an LSTM network to predict agile story points from user story narratives.
papers.findings: Achieves 25% lower MAE than traditional TF-IDF and regression baselines on standardized agile user stories.
papers.documented_limitations: Cross-company transferability issues when agile teams use inconsistent story-point scales and GPU fine-tuning overhead.
papers.suggested_direction: Evaluate lightweight distilled transformers for cross-project agile effort estimation without heavy GPU clusters.

papers.title: Experimental investigation and reliability-based optimization of the nut factor in bolted joints considering friction coefficient, surface roughness and material hardness
papers.methods: Second-order polynomial regression surrogate modeling combined with Monte Carlo Reliability-Based Design Optimization (RBDO).
papers.findings: Captures nonlinear interactions among physical parameters and identifies safe reliability intervals under uncertainty.
papers.documented_limitations: Surrogate regression accuracy degrades near extreme nonlinear boundaries and large Monte Carlo sample sizes increase runtime.
papers.suggested_direction: Compare variance-reduced Quasi-Monte Carlo sampling against standard Monte Carlo in nonlinear RBDO problems.

papers.title: Search model based on Kalman Filter and Monte Carlo simulation
papers.authors: Liu J, Li Y, Liu X
papers.methods: State estimation combining Kalman Filtering, nearest-neighbor correlation, and Monte Carlo trajectory simulation.
papers.findings: Improves multi-target motion prediction accuracy in noisy dynamic environments.
papers.documented_limitations: High computational cost for large particle ensembles during real-time multi-target updates under severe sensor noise.
papers.suggested_direction: Optimize adaptive particle resampling in Kalman-Monte Carlo trackers for constrained workstation CPUs.

papers.title: Sparse-selective quantization for real-time cyber threat detection in high-speed networks
papers.methods: Adaptive sparsity thresholding and selective numerical quantization with Welford streaming statistics for sub-millisecond inference.
papers.findings: Maintains high detection precision while reducing memory bandwidth and latency across CPU and GPU hardware.
papers.documented_limitations: Slow threshold convergence during abrupt distributional shifts (such as sudden traffic floods) and sensitivity to heavy-tailed outliers.
papers.suggested_direction: Design fast change-point detection to stabilize adaptive numerical quantization under sudden data distribution shifts.

papers.title: Comparing Specialised Small and General Large Language Models on Text Classification
papers.methods: Empirical benchmarking of fine-tuned compact encoder models against prompted general Large Language Models on text classification.
papers.findings: Specialized small models match or exceed general LLMs on structured classification tasks at a fraction of inference cost.
papers.documented_limitations: Evaluation restricted to standard text classification benchmarks without testing multi-hop reasoning or low-resource languages.
papers.suggested_direction: Benchmark compact fine-tuned classifiers against prompted LLMs on domain-specific low-resource text datasets.

papers.title: The influence of large language models on academic fields beyond computer science
papers.methods: Bibliometric and cross-disciplinary synthesis of LLM adoption across engineering, medicine, linguistics, and social sciences.
papers.findings: Non-CS fields rely heavily on zero/few-shot general models but rarely report hallucination, bias, or reproducibility checks.
papers.documented_limitations: Lack of standardized domain-adaptation protocols and widespread omission of hallucination and reproducibility evaluations outside CS.
papers.suggested_direction: Create a lightweight domain-grounding and citation-verification benchmark for academic LLM assistants.

papers.title: Hybrid lightweight vision transformers with attention mechanism for feature extraction and classification of product designs
papers.authors: Wahid A, Khan HU, Naz A, Alarfaj FK
papers.methods: Hybrid CNN-Vision Transformer (LeViT) architecture combining local convolutional features with global self-attention.
papers.findings: Achieves 95% classification accuracy while lowering computational complexity compared to pure Vision Transformers.
papers.documented_limitations: Tested primarily on static packaging imagery; generalization to noisy real-time video streams and edge hardware remains limited.
papers.suggested_direction: Evaluate hybrid lightweight vision transformers under real-time lighting variations and low-power edge inference.

papers.title: Decision factors for the selection of AI-based decision support systems
papers.methods: Multi-criteria organizational evaluation of technical, data-quality, and governance factors governing AI-DSS adoption.
papers.findings: Data readiness, transparency, and workflow alignment outweigh raw algorithmic complexity in organizational DSS selection.
papers.documented_limitations: Context-specific organizational sample and lack of longitudinal tracking after system deployment.
papers.suggested_direction: Design an empirical post-adoption evaluation framework linking data quality metrics to DSS decision accuracy.

papers.title: Critical success factors influencing business intelligence adoption: Evidence from Yemen
papers.authors: Al-Adimi AT, Ghilan MM, Yousef WS, Ghallab A
papers.methods: Integrated Technology-Organization-Environment (TOE) framework ranked via Rough Stepwise Weight Assessment Ratio Analysis (R-SWARA).
papers.findings: Data quality, system integration, and information-sharing culture are the decisive bottlenecks for BI database adoption in developing regions.
papers.documented_limitations: Single-country empirical dataset and reliance on cross-sectional expert judgments.
papers.suggested_direction: Develop automated data-quality auditing pipelines for heterogeneous relational databases in resource-constrained organizations.

papers.title: An integrated explainable AI framework with counterfactual optimization for decision support
papers.methods: Constraint-aware counterfactual optimization paired with feature attribution over relational organizational datasets.
papers.findings: Generates actionable, feasible recourse recommendations alongside faithful predictive explanations for managers.
papers.documented_limitations: High optimization latency on high-dimensional enterprise databases and sensitivity to correlated tabular features.
papers.suggested_direction: Accelerate constraint-aware counterfactual generation for multi-table SQL decision support systems.
